scripts.build: npm run build:js && npm run build:css && npm run build:copy
scripts.build:css: npx postcss site/css/landing.css --use postcss-import --no-map -o site/dist/css/landing.css && npx csso-cli site/dist/css/landing.css --output site/dist/css/landing.css && npx postcss site/css/styles.css --use postcss-import --no-map -o site/dist/css/styles.css && npx csso-cli site/dist/css/styles.css --output site/dist/css/styles.css
scripts.build:copy: mkdir -p site/dist/css site/dist/js/vendor site/dist/assets && cp site/index.html site/dist/index.html && cp site/curso.html site/dist/curso.html && cp site/404.html site/dist/404.html && cp site/js/landing.js site/dist/js/landing.js && cp site/js/app.js site/dist/js/app.js && cp site/js/hero3d.js site/dist/js/hero3d.js && cp site/js/vendor/three.bundle.js site/dist/js/vendor/three.bundle.js && cp site/assets/headline-pt.svg site/dist/assets/headline-pt.svg && cp site/assets/headline-en.svg site/dist/assets/headline-en.svg && cp site/css/variables.css site/dist/css/variables.css
scripts.gen:headline: node tools/gen-headline-svg.mjs
